name: buddy
description: The /buddy companion, revived as a mod: random buddies hatched from eggs you earn, each with its own species, rarity, stats and Haiku-written personality, animated above the prompt, reacting to your work, and evolving with you over time.

everyNTurns.title: Speak every N turns
everyNTurns.description: How many finished turns between quips (each quip is one Haiku call).

banterChance.title: Banter chance
banterChance.description: With more than one buddy out: the chance, from 0 to 1, that after a quip the next buddy answers it (one more Haiku call). 0 turns it off.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the buddy's lines, its Haiku quips and personalities, and which epithet it shows.

position.title: Position
position.description: Which side of the band the buddy sits on.

crewSize.title: Crew size
crewSize.description: How many buddies can be out at once. The band shows as many as the terminal has room for, always the one talking; the others are named in its bubble.

active.title: Active buddies
active.description: Names of the buddies to show, comma separated, up to the crew size (e.g. Pip,Mox); empty = every buddy already hatched, your original first. /buddy use, join and leave override it. Unknown names and buddies still in their egg are skipped; with none left, the original comes out.

sessionsPerHatch.title: Sessions per egg
sessionsPerHatch.description: Sessions together for each egg; a ready egg hatches with /buddy.

sessionsPerEvolve.title: Sessions per evolution
sessionsPerEvolve.description: Sessions with a buddy out before it can evolve; /buddy evolve spends it.

buddiesFile.title: Buddies file
buddiesFile.description: JSON list of your extra buddies: { name, species?, personality? }; personality is a string or { tone, traits, quirks, backstory, speech, catchphrase, likes, dislikes }. /buddy add, rm and evolve write to it.
